name: Boku no Shin'yuu ni Sasageru
source:
"The good-looking guy from my memories is now gone... My best friend..."

Kasumi, who had been my best friend back in high school, had jumped off a roof and died over 10 years ago now.
He wanted to do it with me...
I promised we'd do it together, but I ended up running away.

Since then, I've dreamt of Kasumi countless times.
This must be another one of those dreams.
Yet, I'm so aware of it that I feel like I could confuse it for reality.

"I'm dreaming of you today as well."

[Translated from [url=https://www.dlsite.com/bl/work/=/product_id/RJ284151.html]DLsite[/url]]
